summary: Parked north kerb of Macquarie Street, apartments 12 m away, near a junction.
reasons: Short stretch ending at a junction

best_section.where: Macquarie Street north kerb, west of the Laurence Street junction, beside the apartment block

drivers.seclusion: Apartment block 12 m away on the same side; houses 15-24 m across the road.
drivers.access_and_room: Wide sealed street with a parked kerb lane; the east end is the junction mouth, so only the west part fits a van.
drivers.traffic: Local street beside a junction; light traffic.
drivers.convention: Cars park along both kerbs; signs are 2P Mon-Fri with resident permits excepted, plus one P (No Limit) sign.

flags: Apartments 12 m away on the same side
Low-lying: about 5 m elevation, 200 m from the Brisbane River
Junction at the east end, keep clear of the corner
Mixed signs: 2P resident permits excepted and P (No Limit)
sun_shade: Tree canopy over the north side shades the section from morning to midday; open to afternoon sun from the west.
cannot_judge: Which sign applies at the best section
